chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen. Today I am making Bhel Puri. If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel. I have fried 2 bowl of Murmure on a pan. I have added a little turmeric powder as they are soft. Then we will add 1 bowl of chana dal. You can get this in the market. We have added some chopped onions and chopped tomatoes. We have added some fried asafoetida. We have added some spices like chaat masala, black salt, white salt, red chilli powder and green chilli. We will mix it well. We will add some chopped coriander leaves. We will add tamarind chutney. You can add tamarind chutney as per your taste. We will add green chilli, coriander and mint chutney. We will add some lemon juice as per your taste. We will add some sev. We will add some lemon juice. We will add all the flavours as per our taste. We will mix it well. We are making street style bhel. If you like my recipe, please like and share it. We have added coriander leaves. Bhel is ready. We will serve it in a plate. We will serve it in a plate. Tasty!
